title: The Case Against Conversational Interfaces
summary: Analysis of data transfer mechanisms (speed and lossiness) to argue that natural language is inferior to visual/keyboard interfaces for most computing tasks, and that AI should function as a complementary OS-level command layer rather than a replacement for existing workflows.
when-to-read: Read this when evaluating whether conversational or voice interfaces should replace traditional UI paradigms, or when designing AI-assisted tools. If you're interested in why keyboard shortcuts and visual interfaces dominate productivity work despite new AI capabilities, consult this article rather than articles about AI capabilities (ai-engineering tag).
